strategies.guerrero: The ideal play is to stay around 50% health and try to grab the extra health modifiers so that 50% is actually higher, instead of always risking death from a bad decision.
strategies.paladin: The most balanced character, since it fits any playstyle.
strategies.elfo: With the chance to flee up to 2 times per hand, you can think things through better when you push your luck or use your ability.
strategies.mago: The ideal character if you enjoy a slower, calmer pace, since it lets you plan several turns ahead.
strategies.apostador: The most viable option is: not using its ability.
strategies.alquimista: Heal with hearts to trigger the passive and brew every round for whatever the run needs: gold, damage, health or escape.
